interface.longDescription: BrewPilot is a local stdio MCP server for permission-gated Chromium browser automation and scoped local file operations. It can launch an isolated browser profile, navigate to HTTP and HTTPS sites, inspect pages, interact with visible controls, and extract page text, links, or tables. It can list local directories and read, create, overwrite, or delete bounded UTF-8 text files. A deny-by-default local policy engine checks each operation against its capability, operation, and exact resource. File overwrites and deletions, browser interactions that can change remote state, and other risky actions require fresh one-time confirmation. Basic system information is available through an explicitly permission-gated tool. Redacted audit events are kept only in the current server process. Permission policies and the isolated browser profile are stored locally. This release does not include a cloud relay, remote access, terminal execution, process management, or privileged operating-system automation. Browser requests go only to destinations selected by the user. Requires Node.js 22 or newer and a supported Chromium-based browser for browser automation.
defaultPrompt: Open a local browser and inspect a webpage.
List files in my approved local workspace.
